name: Prizm Adaptive
desc: Octopus camouflage: thousands of tiny skin plates that FLIP between two rival palettes by their own grain direction — the surface re-camouflages as you move. Dense papillae micro-bumps.

name: Prizm Alien Skin
desc: Living exo-membrane GROWN by reaction-diffusion: glossy coral-labyrinth ridges over a violet pore-speckled membrane, bioluminescent cyan pulses along every crest.

name: Prizm Arctic
desc: Pack-ice mosaic: ~2600 slim anisotropic ice shards with tight internal striations, frost ferns etched along every seam, trapped-air sparkle throughout.

name: Prizm Aurora Shift
desc: Aurora storm: thousands of sheared light strands with fine ray striations, rippling green-teal-magenta over a star-thick night sky.

name: Prizm Black Rainbow
desc: Obsidian depths cut by razor strange-attractor filigree burning in emissive spectrum colors; dense prismatic micro-flake keeps the black alive.

name: Prizm Blood Moon
desc: Eclipsed regolith: a fully-cratered surface with sun-lit rims, fine ejecta dendrites, mineral glass-bead glints, umbral blood gradient crimson-amber.

name: Prizm Candy Paint
desc: Kustom candy apple: deep Beer-Lambert crimson poured over a FULL engine-turned silver bed — scattered jittered guilloche rosettes + dense metal flake.

name: Prizm Chrome Rose
desc: Liquid rose-gold chrome: tight refraction-caustic mesh streaking across hammered poured metal, rose-champagne, hairline polish swirl.

name: Prizm Copper Flame
desc: Engraved fire: banknote hatching whose line weight follows licking flame tongues — polished copper with teal heat-patina pooling in burnt valleys.

name: Prizm Cosmos
desc: A living galaxy: strange-attractor spiral arms of star-stuff, 30k pin-stars, rose/indigo nebula breathing between the arms.

name: Prizm Dark Matter
desc: Gravitational lensing: a brilliant caustic light-web warped around pitch-black void lace, every void rimmed in violet Cherenkov glow.

name: Prizm Deep Space
desc: Long-exposure sky: 1500 concentric star-trail arcs sweeping around an unseen pole, gold/blue/white trails with hot heads over cosmic dust.

name: Prizm Duochrome
desc: True duochrome twill: a fine herringbone weave where every warp thread is teal and every weft magenta — the color flip IS the fabric.

name: Prizm Ember
desc: Dying campfire crust: charred plates split by a glowing crack network breathing orange-gold heat, spark streaks drifting off the hottest seams.

name: Prizm Fire & Ice
desc: Two rivers interleaved: warm currents flowing one way, glacial the other, woven through alternating bands — frost sparkle where they touch.

name: Prizm Galaxy Dust
desc: Golden-angle stardust: phyllotaxis spirals of micro-spangles at three nested scales, violet dust lanes drifting between the seed-spirals.

name: Prizm Holographic
desc: Holo trading-foil: a mosaic of micro-prism tiles, each etched with a hairline diffraction grating at its own angle — every tile its own rainbow.

name: Prizm Iridescent
desc: Draining soap film: swirling fine thin-film bands with drain streaks and black film holes on a pale pearl base.

name: Prizm Midnight
desc: Nocturne sea: deep indigo swells crossed by hairline moon-silver engraving that follows the water, rare glints riding the crests.

name: Prizm Mystichrome
desc: Liquid color-travel chrome: teal-violet-magenta-gold sweep with molten metal flow-streaks combed along the travel gradient.

name: Prizm Neon
desc: Buzzing neon alley: dense glowing glass-tube script loops (white-hot cores, colored halos) over a dark micro-brick wall.

name: Prizm Oceanic
desc: Sunlit reef floor: true refraction caustics dancing over turquoise-abyss depth, micro-foam flecks riding the bright web.

name: Prizm Phoenix
desc: Rising firebird plumage: long arcing plume strands with fine barb hatching, ember roots burning to white-gold tips, spark dust.

name: Prizm Solar
desc: The photosphere: boiling granulation cells, crisp sunspot pores with penumbrae, white-hot magnetic loop arcs leaping between regions.

name: Prizm Spectrum
desc: Laser-etched spectrum guilloche: a dense scatter of fine jittered engine-turn rosettes, each refracting its own slice of the rainbow.

name: Prizm Sunset Strip
desc: Retro-chrome dusk: warm gradient sky swept by narrow mirror-chrome bands at scattered angles, micro scanline shimmer — 80s boulevard.

name: Prizm Titanium
desc: Torch-anodized titanium: brushed metal grain blooming through the anodize spectrum (straw-bronze-violet-cobalt), grinder arcs biting in.

name: Prizm Toxic Waste
desc: Bubbling biohazard sludge: reaction-diffusion foam, rim-lit rising bubbles, acid drips cutting the crust — violent green on black.

name: Prizm Venom
desc: Serpent armor: brick-packed keeled diamond scales, iridescent green-black with venom-yellow lattice flashes, every keel catching light.

name: Old Glory Flux
desc: The flag as pure energy: scarlet and bone current-ribbons streaming through a shared wind, weaving over/under, star-spangled indigo eddies.

name: We The People
desc: The parchment itself: dense copperplate engraving flowing like handwriting, iron-gall ink on foxed vellum, gold illumination curls.

name: Bunting Scallop
desc: Layered bunting swags: overlapping scallop fans with fine pleat hatching and sagging cords, scattered at several angles.

name: Firework Radial
desc: Dense peony fireworks: full rings of drooping spark rays with dot terminals and strobe rings, sizes nested so the sky is FULL.

name: Ribbon Weave
desc: True over-under satin ribbon lattice: two interlaced ribbon families, each striped with a sheen line and edge shading.

name: Star Lattice
desc: Stars made of stars: 5-point outlines whose strokes are strings of micro-stars, at three nested scales — a constellation lattice.

name: Stencil Stars
desc: Spray-stencil stars: crisp filled cutouts, overspray halo speckle, paint drips running off random edges.

name: Stripe Drift
desc: Pinstriper's drift: fine parallel pinstripes flowing around invisible discs (potential flow) — stripes part and rejoin like water.

name: Corridor Sheen (spec)
desc: Micro-pleated satin corridors: three independent angle families of FINE pleat banding; cross-grain satin; corridor pooling.

name: Firework Radial (spec)
desc: Micro-burst glint field: dense radial spark spokes; signed smoke rings; afterglow pools around burst hearts.

name: Sparkler Embers (spec)
desc: Sparkler in the dark: thousands of micro-star pins; crackle branch twigs; drifting ember decay pools.

name: Starfield Scatter (spec)
desc: Deep night starfield, rebuilt FAST (old one hung): multi-magnitude stars with diffraction spikes; nebula grain; constellation corridors.

name: Torch Flicker (spec)
desc: Torch flame anisotropy: fine flame-tongue hatching licking one way; heat-shimmer ripple; torch pool glow.

name: Crackle Network (spec)
desc: Hierarchical crackle, rebuilt FAST (old one hung for minutes): two nested anisotropic crack webs + micro-twigs.

name: Abalone Crack Inlay (spec)
desc: Nacre shards with interference banding along each shard's grain, dark grout channels — rebuilt fast.
